name: WarehouseFlow RSchema v1

columns.name: capacity
columns.definition: Maximum total stock units; synthetic unit convention

tables.definition: Inbound/outbound task header, one business occurrence per row

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC completion time of recorded task; instant-event convention

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.definition: IN = Goods Received; OUT = Goods Dispatched

tables.definition: Goods lines per transaction; composite key prevents repeated goods within one task

columns.name: quantity
columns.definition: Positive number of units of this goods type moved by the transaction

tables.definition: Worker assignment bridge; multiple workers may share one task

columns.name: event_id
columns.definition: Stable identity of this actual business action; authored extension

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.definition: Explicit parent object key; FK to transaction_record.transaction_id

columns.name: activity
columns.definition: Controlled business activity label; not a technical database update

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.definition: Actual occurrence time in UTC, distinct from planned dates

columns.name: outcome
columns.definition: Recorded action outcome: COMPLETED, APPROVED or REVISION_REQUIRED

tables.definition: Explicit case attribution across typed action histories; auxiliary extraction index, not a business case

columns.name: event_id
columns.definition: Validated identity in a typed activity table; polymorphic reference

columns.name: case_id
columns.definition: Serialized primary key of the declared case table; composite parts separated by colon

business_rules: Original source layer: One transaction header is one warehouse business event, regardless of goods-line or worker counts.
Original source layer: IN adds quantity; OUT removes quantity. Stock is never negative, and total stock stays within warehouse capacity.
Original source layer: Transactions have at least one goods line and one worker assignment.
Original source layer: Goods details and worker assignments enrich events; joining them must not multiply header events.
Original source layer: A transaction ID does not link an inbound task to a later outbound task as a shipment lifecycle.
Original source layer: The default warehouse view contains all recorded IN/OUT transactions for that warehouse.
Original source layer: Only completion instants are recorded. Task start times and durations cannot be inferred.
Original source layer: Master records and worker assignments are not additional business events.
Original source rows are preserved. Added typed activity histories are authored synthetic domain extensions, not claimed source fields.
Only actual occurred_at times generate lifecycle events. Planned dates and technical timestamps remain excluded.
Lifecycle case links use exact typed object identity. Related cases may share an event; uniqueness is (case_id,event_id).
Incomplete cases and conditional revision branches are intentional; no final action is inferred for an open case.

object_activity_design.scenario: Actual ordered actions; every seventh object stops before closure. Assignment/thesis revision branches occur in one third of objects.
object_activity_design.origin: Authored domain extension; absent from original RSchema/manufacturer metadata
